title: France's cheese producers worry after summer of heatwaves: 'If this happens again next year, it will be a disaster'
subhead: Heatwaves have taken a heavy toll on milk production, while scorched pastures have forced farmers to draw on feed reserves normally kept for winter. Producers of many protected-origin cheeses can no longer comply with the rules set out in their official specifications and are concerned about the future.

title: The Suez Canal's early years, under the shadow of the French and British empires
subhead: 'Suez, a historic canal' (3/6). From 1880 to 1914, Egypt received less than 1% of the revenue generated by the Suez Canal Company. That income illustrated the United Kingdom's and France's domination of the waterway's management at the beginning of the 20th century.

title: Russian commentator Xenia Fedorova's highly political 'escape'
subhead: The media personality, a protégée of French billionaire Vincent Bolloré, passed through Nice at the end of July before disappearing following an expulsion order from France. Her candidacy to lead a Berlin cultural center closely tied to the Kremlin sparked a wave of political reactions in Germany.

title: 'We can't water a forest': Switzerland is testing a forestry method to protect against wildfires
